# Website Screenshot Generator

The Apify actor [`apify/screenshot-url`](https://apify.com/apify/screenshot-url) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.66**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Create a screenshot of a website based on a specified URL. The screenshot is stored as the output in a key-value store. It can be used to monitor web changes regularly after setting up the scheduler.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/screenshot-url) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-screenshot-url@0.0.66#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      waitUntil: "load"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `urls` | array |  |  | List of URLs — List of URLs you want to take screenshots of. |
| `format` | string |  | `"png"` | Format — Screenshot file format. |
| `waitUntil` | string | yes |  | Wait until — Control's when will the browser take a screenshot |
| `delay` | integer | yes | `0` | Delay before screenshot — Add's delay before a screenshot is taken. Minimum is 0, maximum is 5 minutes (3600000ms) |
| `viewportWidth` | integer | yes | `1280` | Width — How wide should the website's viewport be |
| `scrollToBottom` | boolean |  | `false` | Scroll to bottom — Should the browser scroll to the bottom of the page before taking a screenshot |
| `delayAfterScrolling` | integer |  | `2500` | Delay After Scrolling — Specify the delay (in milliseconds) after scrolling to the bottom of the page before taking the screenshot. This option is only used if 'Wait for Network Idle After Scrolling' is not enabled. |
| `waitUntilNetworkIdleAfterScroll` | boolean |  | `false` | Wait for Network Idle After Scrolling (Overrides "Delay After Scrolling" option) — Choose whether to wait for the network to become idle after scrolling to the bottom of the page before taking a screenshot. If enabled, this option overrides the 'Delay After Scrolling' option. |
| `waitUntilNetworkIdleAfterScrollTimeout` | integer |  | `30000` | Network Idle Timeout — Specify the maximum wait time (in milliseconds) for the network to become idle after scrolling to the bottom of the page before taking the screenshot, this option is used to make sure handler doesn't get stuck for some pages. This option is only used if 'Wait for Network Idle  |
| `proxy` | object |  | `{"useApifyProxy":true}` | Proxy configuration — Set the proxy configuration of the scraper |
| `selectorsToHide` | string |  | `""` | Selectors to hide — List of selectors to hide before taking a screenshot |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
